messages:
ana: Heads-up: the python quickstart sample app is getting stuck on streamed responses when upstream returns a 403 with body 'quota exceeded' — SDK treats that as retryable and keeps resuming the stream.

ori: Oof. Which python SDK version? Is this the new streaming buffer change from last week?

ana: it's python-sdk 1.4.0 from the quickstart image. repro: run `python demo_stream.py` with a limited API key, hit the quota, you see partial tokens printed then nothing until backoff ends.

sam: That sounds like two problems: (1) classification of 4xx auth/limit errors vs transient 5xx, (2) streaming semantics — we should abort stream on client-visible errors and emit a terminal typed error event.

ana: here's the trace snippet:
```
INFO:stream:open connection
DATA: token
DATA: token
ERROR:transport status=403 body="quota exceeded"
WARN:sdk:attempting resume; attempt=1
```

ori: We recently tightened resume logic to be permissive for server hiccups, but forgot to check error codes. For streaming we should not resume for 4xx.

pm-zoe: For onboarding UX this is critical — users think streaming is unreliable. Can we add a small helper `error.retry_hint` that is one of ["none","refresh_token","backoff","contact_support"]? Sample apps can show the action.

sam: I like `retry_hint`. Suggest naming values slightly different: `none`, `refresh_token`, `rate_limit`, `transient`. Keep it small and stable.

ana: implementation idea: runtime should include structured error JSON when possible: `{"code":"quota.exceeded","message":"quota exceeded","retry_hint":"rate_limit"}`. SDK parsing order: status code -> structured code -> message regex.

ori: SDK owners: we need two changes in python-sdk 1.4.1: (A) stream: on receiving an error frame with 4xx -> emit typed `ClientError` and stop resumptions; (B) add `is_retryable(err)` util that checks status, `code`, and `retry_hint`.

sam: Also add a tiny example in quickstart:
```python
try:
    for chunk in client.stream_generate(prompt):
        print(chunk)
except ClientError as e:
    if e.retry_hint == 'refresh_token':
        auth.refresh()
    elif e.retry_hint == 'rate_limit':
        print('hit quota; show upgrade CTA')
    else:
        raise
```

pm-zoe: please also ensure the error object carries `request_id` and `status` so ops can correlate.

ana: created runtime issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/issues/472 and python-sdk draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/python-sdk/pull/411 (wip).

ori: I'll add a unit test for streaming: simulate a 403 mid-stream and assert that stream terminates with ClientError and no resume attempts.

sam: QA note: when the proxy layer rewrites 403->502 (some infra thing), the classifier should fall back to message/code parsing so we still surface `rate_limit`.

pm-zoe: prioritization: mark quickstart/emergency docs update P1 for onboarding. Product will triage after the PRs land.

sdk-bot: New issue created: runtime#472 by ana. New PR opened: python-sdk#411 by ana (draft).

ori: assigning myself to python-sdk PR review. ETA: tomorrow morning.

ana: thanks all — I'll add a short note to the streaming sample app that explains `retry_hint` semantics and show the snippet above.

sam: one last ask: add 'IsRateLimitError(err)' convenience func in all SDKs so sample apps don't need regex.

ori: good call. we'll add it to the cross-language error spec.

pm-zoe: thanks team, keeping this on the onboarding bug until quickstart is updated. :white_check_mark:
